lan.label: Same Wi-Fi
lan.blurb: Fastest to set up. Reachable by devices on your network. Not encrypted, and phones cannot install it as an app.
lan.findIp: You're viewing this on localhost, which phones can't reach. Find this machine's network IP:
lan.openWithPort: On your phone (same Wi-Fi), open that address with the port:
lan.leaveEmpty: Leave the Public URL field below empty for this mode.
lan.openExact: Open this exact address on your phone (it must be on the same Wi-Fi):

tailscale.label: Tailscale
tailscale.blurb: A private, encrypted URL only your own devices can reach. No public exposure and no domain required.
tailscale.install: Install Tailscale on this machine and your phone, signed into the same account:
tailscale.up: Bring this machine onto your tailnet:
tailscale.serve: Serve this app over HTTPS on your tailnet:
tailscale.paste: Tailscale prints an https URL ending in .ts.net — paste it into Public URL below.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare Tunnel
cloudflare.blurb: A public https URL. A quick tunnel takes seconds with no account; a named tunnel gives a permanent URL on your domain.
cloudflare.quick: Quick, temporary URL (no account): start a tunnel, then copy the https://<name>.trycloudflare.com address it prints and paste it below.
cloudflare.permanent: Permanent URL on your own domain (needs a free Cloudflare account with your domain added to it): log in, create a named tunnel, point a DNS record at it, then run it.
cloudflare.paste: Paste your https URL into Public URL below.

domain.label: Your own domain
domain.blurb: A permanent https URL on a domain you own, via Caddy — certificates are issued automatically.
domain.dns: Point an A record for your (sub)domain at this server's public IP.
domain.run: Start Caddy — it fetches a Let's Encrypt certificate automatically:
domain.paste: Paste https://flights.example.com into Public URL below.
